joy.objective: weighted average of exact front/back hits from each signal's best historical ticket; no curve-fit, frequency, overdue, balance, or pattern bonus is added to hit score

kane.objective: weighted average of exact front/back hits from each signal's best historical ticket; no curve-fit, frequency, overdue, balance, or pattern bonus is added to hit score

rule: Each agent searches one million independent signal-weight candidates. The objective is based only on exact historical front/back hit counts. Historical sealed predictions are not rewritten.
